subject: sky.records

entries.definition: The Sky ecosystem, formerly MakerDAO, in which the organization operates; the umbrella for its stars, agents, and governance artifacts. As a document subject area, it means ecosystem-development coordination and operations and applies only when no narrower governed subject area fits.
The Sky Atlas, the ecosystem governance rulebook whose articles are cited as A.x.y links.
A governance or protocol action executed onchain as a spell.
The Monthly Settlement Cycle, the Sky ecosystem monthly financial settlement covering PnL methodology, debt-mint mechanics, ER calculations, and settlement reporting.
A semi-autonomous sub-organization of the Sky ecosystem, onboarded through the Star Onboarding process.
An agent-organization rank in the ecosystem agent framework and a portable organization classification.
The NFAT product line: Beacon, Configurator, and Relay.
The Sky incentive program rewarding partners for distributing Sky products such as USDS to end users, including its tracking, calculation, and payout material.
The Sky incentive program rewarding platforms for integrating Sky assets, including eligibility, tracking, and payouts.
The Sky incentive program rewarding work that makes Sky governance accessible and participatory.
The Sky incentive program rewarding early deployments of Sky assets on new chains.
Internal team administration and operations, including accounts, workspace, signer operations, and day-to-day runbooks.
Legal entities, agreements, resolutions, trademarks, and compliance material.
Partner and client acquisition and relationships, including proposals, offers, outreach, and client questions and answers.
Budgets, funding requests, and organizational financial self-assessment and reporting; this is money about the organization, while MSC is ecosystem settlement.
Operational execution of payments and settlements, including payout runs, weekly payments, and transaction operations; this is execution, while MSC is methodology.
The DeFi protocols and products the organization operates on or with, including market mechanics and launches.
Curating and managing DeFi vaults, including parameters, allocation, and risk monitoring.
The Sky cross-chain bridge, including deployments, checklists, freezer or pause operations, and chain sanity checks.
The organization AI-agent tooling and automation, including meeting intelligence and agent standards.
Brand, marketing content, and intellectual property, including trademarks, naming, and public materials.

limitations: This vocabulary defines portable organizational meaning only; it does not interpret governance, resolve Atlas citations, classify live provider records, or grant operational authority.
Provider and policy projections must bind this exact artifact and fail visibly on drift; copied definitions never become canonical.
